high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie outdoors on a sunny day. The individual has long, dark, curly hair and is wearing glasses with black frames. They appear to be smiling and are dressed in a sleeveless top. On their left shoulder, there is a visible tattoo of a feather. In the background, there is a paved pathway lined with greenery, including bushes and trees. There are also some streetlights and a solar panel mounted on one of them. Further back, there are buildings, including a white structure that appears to be a small office or facility.
